_comment: Long-context extension 2k → 16k (Smol Training Playbook / ABF): start from the finished 2k model, raise the RoPE base 10k → 1M, train ~400M tokens of long documents (tokenize_corpus.py --min_tokens 4096) with a fresh short schedule. 1×16384×6 = 98k tokens/step × 4k steps. Check with a needle-in-a-haystack test afterwards. A100 80GB; gradient checkpointing + chunked CE keep 16k activations in memory.
